# awesome-mcp-servers

> A curated catalog of verified, working Model Context Protocol servers for AI clients, labeled with publisher, runtime, and capability metadata.

The project is a maintained list of MCP servers compatible with Claude Desktop and other clients. It categorizes tools by function and labels each entry with status tags such as official, community, read-only, or mutating. Entries are verified weekly to ensure they remain functional and honest.

## Docs

- [awesome-mcp-servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/main/README.md): A catalog of working MCP servers, labelled by publisher, runtime, permissions, and licensing status.
- [Why this list exists](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists): Inclusion criteria for real, working, honest MCP servers, plus labeling rules for publishers, runtime, and payment methods.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#legend): Definitions for labels indicating publisher type, mutation capability, runtime location, payment requirements, and listing recency.
- [Reference servers (MCP steering group)](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#reference-servers-mcp-steering-group): Official reference implementations from the MCP steering group, including filesystem, git, memory, and sequential thinking servers.
- [Files, Filesystem & Local Data](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#files-filesystem--local-data): Community server for reading, searching, editing, and deleting notes in an Obsidian vault via the Local REST API.
- [Web Search & Browsing](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#web-search--browsing): Servers for web search, browsing, and documentation retrieval, including Brave, Context7, and CurlShot.
- [Browser Automation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#browser-automation): Servers for browser automation and macOS control, including Browser Use, Chrome DevTools, and mac-mcp.
- [Source Control](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#source-control): Servers for source control systems, including Gitea, GitHub, and GitLab, with repository and issue management.
- [Issue Trackers & Project Management](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#issue-trackers--project-management): Servers for issue tracking and project management, including Asana, Atlassian, Linear, Orbit, and Trello.
- [Communication](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#communication): Servers for communication platforms, including social media posting, Discord, and Google Workspace integration.
- [Relational Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#relational-databases): Servers for relational databases, including ClickHouse, MySQL, Postgres, and Supabase, with query and schema tools.
- [NoSQL & Document Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#nosql--document-databases): Official MongoDB and Neo4j servers for querying, CRUD operations, and graph database management.
- [Vector & Memory Stores](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#vector--memory-stores): Persistent agent memory, ChromaDB vector search, and claimidx tools for storing and retrieving data.
- [Productivity & Notes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#productivity--notes): Servers for Airtable, Apple Notes, Google Calendar, Notion, and Process Street productivity and note-taking.
- [Design & Creative](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#design--creative): Tools for video editing, Figma design integration, Blender 3D modeling, and local video composition.
- [Operations & Infrastructure](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#operations--infrastructure): Official MCP servers for AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, and Datadog cloud infrastructure and operations.
- [AI & ML Platforms](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#ai--ml-platforms): Gateways and servers for Aident, API.market, Hugging Face, and Runapi AI and ML platforms.
- [Specialised / Vertical](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#specialised--vertical): Hosted servers for health records, data-center site selection, and financial market data with various access tiers.
- [Frameworks & SDKs for Building MCP Servers](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#frameworks--sdks-for-building-mcp-servers): Official and community SDKs for building MCP servers in Python, Go, and TypeScript, including version notes.
- [Discovery hubs](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#discovery-hubs): Reference repositories, community lists, and hosted registries for discovering new MCP servers.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Curated lists of AI coding agents, local AI tools, and privacy-focused AI architectures.
